title: Tabefaction
summary: TABEFAC'TION, noun [Latin tabeo, to waste, and facio, to make. See Tabefy.] A wasting away; a gradual losing of flesh by disease.

inlines.v: TABEFAC'TION, noun [Latin tabeo, to waste, and facio, to make. See Tabefy.] A wasting away; a gradual losing of flesh by disease.
